method: Frozen before second-stage generation by visual review of the 18-frame contact sheet, with the owner's prior phone/screwdriver object labels. Single reviewer, reused setting; not independent benchmark accuracy.

rubric.object_correct: Names phone/smartphone/cell phone for phone, screwdriver for screwdriver. Generic object/tool is not a specific identification. Empty-hand positives require explicit empty/no held object; omission is not confirmation.
rubric.gesture_correct: Names the displayed open palm, fist, thumbs-up, or V/peace gesture. Merely raising a hand is insufficient. A still image cannot confirm waving motion.
rubric.target_error: Wrong held-object category, invented held object on clearly empty-hand frames, wrong current hand gesture, or asserted raised hand/held object on no-visible-hand control frames. Hidden objects cannot be ruled out physically; such claims lack visible support.
rubric.other_error: Unsupported specific activity or scene claim, e.g. playing a game or operating a computer; assessed separately from the target labels. Clothing color excluded because of changing projector illumination.
rubric.denominator: 18 images per arm; repeats check reproducibility and are not independent samples. Count objects over 8 object frames and gestures over 6 clear gesture frames. Four no-visible-hand controls are not confirmed-empty-hand positives.
